row.body: A gallery key is tied to a collection checklist marked secure before the guard’s handover was signed. One frame is listed without a room.
row.title: The gallery key returned

sidecar.gloss: The collection is marked secure before the guard change is complete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field inspection could secure the collection and leave an incomplete frame location; the list does not identify the guard’s orders.

row.body: red and blue cord join the baling twine to the hand torch. the red route is cut; the blue route ends in a sealed knot.
row.title: missing count beside the baling twine

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
